text:
The evidence confirms **67.7 ha of tree-cover loss in 2020**, but it does not establish whether that loss was deforestation. Tree-cover loss alone does not show whether forest was permanently converted to another land use.

The 2020 loss occurred before the assessment’s 31 December 2020 baseline. From 2021 through 2025, no loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected, although 0.4 ha of loss in smaller patches was recorded in 2021. This assessment does not establish regulatory compliance or that the property is deforestation-free.
